name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MaskedGGH15.masked_decrypt
title: Masked GGH15 WE: decryption on a witness returns the canonical mask (exact identity mod q)
statement: For every output (A, D) of the GGH15 encoding of the masked candidate's secrets diag(R_i, M_{i,b} (x) S'_{i,b}, S_{i,b}) with top matrix A_h, there are errors E such that for every satisfying assignment x of Psi, exactly over Z_q: (J_O A_0) D_x - (J_C A_0) D_x = 1_n (x) mask + (J_O - J_C) err_x, with mask = (r_0 R_*) A_h^mask and err_x the GGH15 error of encode_path_identity.
